newsitem.title: UK: Smith & Nephew seeks cartilage trial go-ahead.
newsitem.headline: Smith & Nephew seeks cartilage trial go-ahead.

text.p: British healthcare group Smith & Nephew Plc said on Friday it applied to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to begin a clinical trial with human tissue engineered articular cartilage.

Smith & Nephew said it set up a worldwide joint venture with Advanced Tissue Sciences to develop orthopaedic products in 1994, initially focusing on the repair of articular cartilage problems in knee joints.
The company said there were currently no commercially available, off-the-shelf products to repair damaged cartilage, adding that knee injuries were the most common sports injury.
Smith & Nephew said it had submitted an Investigational Device Exemption application to the FDA.
